candidates.original_title: Inhibition of BET recruitment to chromatin as an effective treatment for MLL-fusion leukaemia
candidates.description: I-BET151 selectively inhibits the growth of MLL-fusion leukaemic MV4;11 cells compared to non-MLL-fusion K-562 cells
candidates.citation_sentence: This experiment is comparable to what was reported in Figure 2A and Supplementary Figure 11A-B of Dawson et al. (2011) and described in Protocols 1–2 in the Registered Report (Fung et al., 2015).
candidates.notes: Authors explicitly state results were in the same direction as the original and statistically significant where predicted. [ling26: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: Inhibition of BET recruitment to chromatin as an effective treatment for MLL-fusion leukaemia
candidates.description: I-BET151 treatment increases survival in a xenograft mouse model of MLL-fusion leukaemia
candidates.citation_sentence: In order to test the efficacy of I-BET151 as a therapeutic agent in MLL-fusion leukaemia, we sought to replicate an experiment similar to what was reported in Figure 4B and D and Supplementary Figure 16A (Dawson et al., 2011) and described in Protocols 4–5 in the Registered Report (Fung et al., 2015).
candidates.notes: Survival result was a failure (p=0.536, opposite direction from original), but disease burden was in the same direction as the original. Mixed signals within one experiment yield inconclusive. [ling26: extra entry, not in the external record]
